usdRate.sourceName: Trading Economics, USD/XAF market rate, 30 October 2026
usdRate.note: Secondary source: the CFA franc is pegged to the euro at 655.957 and BEAC publishes no daily dollar rate on a page that could be read; World Bank 2025 average 581.9 per dollar.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Institut National de la Statistique (INS), monthly consumer price note, July 2026
inflation_cpi.note: Consumer prices up 3.4% year on year in July 2026 (3.0% in June, 2.7% in May); 12-month average 2.6%, below the CEMAC 3% convergence norm. Latest INS release found.

inflation_projection.sourceName: BEAC monetary policy committee, 28 September 2026 (CEMAC inflation norm 3%); World Bank CPI inflation 2021-2025
inflation_projection.note: The CFA franc is pegged to the euro and the CEMAC norm is 3% (BEAC forecasts 2.9% for Cameroon in 2026), but inflation averaged about 5% over 2021-2025, so 3.5% a year is used for long-range plans.

policy_rate.sourceName: Banque des Etats de l'Afrique Centrale (BEAC), monetary policy committee press release, 28 September 2026
policy_rate.note: Tender rate (taux d'intérêt des appels d'offres) held at 4.50% after a cut from 4.75% on 29 June 2026; marginal lending facility 5.75%, deposit facility 0%. BEAC sets rates for all six CEMAC countries.

savings_account_rate.sourceName: BEAC Monetary Policy Report, September 2026, annex: Taux Créditeur Minimum (TCM)
savings_account_rate.note: Minimum rate banks in CEMAC must pay on passbook savings of individuals up to 5 million FCFA, 2.45%, unchanged since 8 July 2014; banks usually pay this floor.

fdr_3m_rate.note: No published typical 3-month term-deposit rate for Cameroon was found; deposit rates other than the savings minimum are set freely since 2008 (BEAC).

fdr_1y_rate.note: No published typical 1-year term-deposit rate for Cameroon was found; BEAC's credit-cost bulletins stop in 2022.

dps_rate.note: No industry-wide rate for a monthly recurring deposit was found.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: World Bank WDI, deposit interest rate (FR.INR.DPST), Cameroon
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: 2.45% for 2018, the latest year published (older than 2025); in CEMAC this series follows the BEAC minimum savings rate (TCM).

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: The State sells bonds to the public through public offerings (emprunts obligataires) listed on the regional exchange, but the current coupon could not be read (the exchange's bond page needs scripts).

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: BEAC, yield curve of Cameroonian government securities, July 2026, 3 months
tbill_91d_rate.note: 3-month yield 6.28% (6 months 7.09%, 1 year 8.18%) on Treasury bills (BTA) auctioned through the BEAC.

tbond_5y_rate.sourceName: BEAC, yield curve of Cameroonian government securities, July 2026, 5 years
tbond_5y_rate.note: 5-year yield 9.65% on Treasury bonds (OTA); the curve is flat at about 9.6% from 3 to 15 years.

tbond_10y_rate.sourceName: BEAC, yield curve of Cameroonian government securities, July 2026, 10 years

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Cameroon, individual income determination (income from stocks and shares)
tax_bank_interest.note: Income from deposits, current accounts and other investment income is taxed at an overall 16.5% (15% plus additional council tax); page last reviewed 14 August 2026.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: The tax treatment of interest on public bond offerings and Treasury securities for individuals could not be confirmed from an official source; PwC gives the general 16.5% on investment income without mentioning government securities.

deposit_insurance_limit.sourceName: Deposit Guarantee Fund of Central Africa (FOGADAC), FAQ
deposit_insurance_limit.note: FOGADAC repays guaranteed deposits up to 8 million FCFA for individuals (15 million for legal persons); it covers banks in all six CEMAC countries, including Cameroon.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap or typical credit-card rate was found; BEAC abolished the maximum lending rate in 2008.

equity_return_low.sourceName: BEAC yield curve, July 2026; regional exchange (BVMAC) with few listings
equity_return_low.note: Low case: the regional exchange has few listed shares and a short record, so shares may only match deposits.

equity_return_base.sourceName: BEAC yield curve, July 2026 (1-year 8.18%, about 6.8% after the 16.5% tax)
equity_return_base.note: Base case: the local market is thin with a weak record, so this blends a few local shares with a global index in euro-pegged CFA terms, below the after-tax one-year bill rate plus 4 points.

equity_return_high.note: High case: about the 5-year Treasury yield plus a modest premium.

gold_return_low.sourceName: CFA franc-euro peg; Trading Economics USD/XAF
gold_return_low.note: Low case: flat gold in euro terms.

gold_return_base.sourceName: CFA franc-euro peg; Trading Economics USD/XAF
gold_return_base.note: Base case: long-run dollar gold trend of about 4-5% a year with the euro peg holding.

gold_return_high.sourceName: CFA franc-euro peg; Trading Economics USD/XAF
gold_return_high.note: High case: strong gold prices as in 2019-2025.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: BEAC minimum savings rate (TCM) 2.45%, taxed at 16.5% (PwC)
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: passbook savings at about the regulated minimum, after tax.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: BEAC yield curve, July 2026 (1-year 8.18%); PwC 16.5% tax on investment income
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: a mix of savings, term deposits and public bond offerings, below the after-tax one-year bill rate (about 6.8%).

fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: government bonds near 9.6% less tax.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: No industry-wide life claim settlement ratio for Cameroon was found in CIMA's public pages.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: No published term-life premium rates per 1,000 FCFA of cover were found from CIMA or another public source.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical cost of a major private hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: No published private health insurance premiums per 100,000 FCFA of cover were found.

oop_health_share.sourceName: World Bank WDI, out-of-pocket expenditure (% of current health expenditure), SH.XPD.OOPC.CH.ZS

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: INS consumer price note, July 2026: health index 102.4 (base 2022=100)
goal_inflation_health.note: The health price index has risen only about 0.6% a year since 2022, but it tracks public tariffs and medicines; private care costs are planned at 4%, a little above the 3.5% general assumption.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: INS consumer price note, July 2026: education index 107.3 (base 2022=100)
goal_inflation_education.note: The education index has risen about 1.8% a year since 2022 (1.0% in the year to July 2026); education costs are planned at the 3.5% general assumption to allow for private fees.

life_expectancy.sourceName: World Bank WDI, life expectancy at birth, total (SP.DYN.LE00.IN)

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 (medium variant) for 2026; totals at 60, 70 and 80 are the mean of men and women (only the 65 total, 13.2, is published there).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 5.03 (2025, World Bank), 6.0 (2040) and 10.3 (2065, populationpyramid.net/cameroon/2065/).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: CLEISS (French social security liaison body), the Cameroon social security system: CNPS old-age pension
retirement_age_default.note: Pension at 60 with 20 years of registration and 180 months of insurance; early pension from 50 for premature wear or by agreement. Source describes the 2024 rules (older than 2025).

retirement_age_government.sourceName: Presidency of the Republic of Cameroon, news: retirement age of civil servants harmonised
retirement_age_government.note: Civil servants of categories A and B retire at 60 and categories C and D at 55 under the 2020 harmonisation decree (older than 2025; no later change found).

retirement_return_low.sourceName: BEAC minimum savings rate (TCM) 2.45%, taxed at 16.5% (PwC)
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: passbook savings after tax.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: BEAC yield curve, July 2026 (1-year Treasury bill 8.18%, about 6.8% after the 16.5% tax)
retirement_return_base.note: Base case: safe instruments (savings, term deposits, public bond offerings) below the after-tax one-year bill rate.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: BEAC yield curve, July 2026 (1-year Treasury bill 8.18%)
retirement_return_high.note: High case: close to the one-year bill rate after tax.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case: mostly savings with a small share of shares.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: BEAC yield curve, July 2026; equity base 7%
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: a balanced mix of fixed income (5%) and shares (7%).

retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case: more government bonds and shares in a good decade.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: No non-contributory old-age pension was found; CLEISS describes only the contributory CNPS scheme, including voluntary insurance for informal workers.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: No non-contributory old-age pension eligibility rules were found.

gratuity_rule.note: The Labour Code provides a dismissal indemnity, but no official text giving a statutory end-of-service or retirement gratuity for private employees could be read.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: CLEISS (French social security liaison body), the Cameroon social security system: CNPS old-age pension
public_pension_scheme.note: Compulsory CNPS pension for private employees: 30% of average monthly earnings (best of last 3 or 5 years) plus 1% per 12 months beyond 180 months, between 50% of the minimum wage and 80% of earnings; lump sum (allocation de vieillesse) if fewer than 180 months. No automatic indexation is described. Source is 2024 (older than 2025).

savings_account.note: Banks must pay at least the BEAC minimum savings rate (TCM, 2.45%) on passbook savings up to 5 million FCFA.

fdr_3m.note: Rates are set freely by banks; no published average was found.

fdr_1y.note: Rates are set freely by banks; no published average was found.

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product was found.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: The State periodically sells bonds to individuals through public offerings listed on the regional stock exchange; no fixed savings certificate exists.

tbill_91d.note: Auctioned through the BEAC to primary dealers; individuals buy through them.

equity_fund.note: No diversified retail index or mutual fund was confirmed; the regional exchange (BVMAC) lists few shares.

gold.note: No retail market for investment gold bars or coins was found.

centralBank.name: Banque des Etats de l'Afrique Centrale (BEAC)
centralBank.note: Regional central bank of the six CEMAC countries.

insuranceRegulator.name: Conférence Interafricaine des Marchés d'Assurances (CIMA), regional insurance regulator

pensionScheme.name: Caisse Nationale de Prévoyance Sociale (CNPS), old-age pension
pensionScheme.note: Site did not respond when checked on 31 October 2026.

publicHealthCover.name: Couverture Santé Universelle (CSU), Ministry of Public Health

depositInsurance.name: Deposit Guarantee Fund of Central Africa (Fonds de Garantie des Dépôts en Afrique Centrale, FOGADAC)
